method.threadFixtures: Unchanged baseline driver fixtures: 50/500/2000 rows; filtered dark:2000:1440; 50-message first page; strict 39-page load, stable anchor, 16 synthetic tokens at configured 60ms delay

method.percentiles: Median and nearest-rank p95; with n=3 p95=max, not stable population estimates.
method.diagnostics: Separate one-per-source GC + 1kHz sampled stream CPU pair, excluded from timing comparisons. GC and CPU profiling alter execution.

findings.finding: Visible-update gap threshold exceeds10% in main n3 comparison; exact source cause remains unproved
findings.confidence: high observed distribution, low causal attribution
findings.evidence: Main max-visible-gap median170.8->208.5ms (+22.1%), p95189.7->217.6(+14.7%). Arrival maxima70.8/72.6/72.8 ->70.3/71.5/111.7ms. Both source versions use unchanged80ms timer+requestAnimationFrame with60ms nominal token cadence; token groups vary2-3. Separate GC/CPU pair reverses gap206.1->146.1ms. Current sampled JS CPU is not higher; cannot call this transport-packet or isolated React regression.

findings.finding: Small-fixture full-history search tail is before response headers, not delayed sidebar DOM batching
findings.evidence: Request duration baseline17.1/21.5/18.1ms vs current43.0/36.4/83.6ms; no other finished resource overlaps those search requests. Post-response-to-sample5.5-5.8ms vs5.7-23.5ms. Need server-handler/SessionDB timing before changing FTS or debounce. Separate10k warm p95 passes on both sources.

findings.finding: Raw heap tail is GC-sensitive; one retained-heap pair leaves a small increase open
findings.confidence: high GC sensitivity; low attribution/leak confidence
findings.evidence: Ordinary heap baseline26.9-50.5MiB, current40.6-56.8MiB; medians+5.9%, max+12.3%. Forced GC baseline20.37MiB/current22.58MiB (+10.9%,2.21MiB), only one pair. No repeated navigation/leak slope or retained-object allocation proof.
